description: This file defines a utility enum 'LoopbackHost' providing methods to determine if a given host is a loopback or local network host. It includes functions to analyze host strings, parse IP addresses, and recognize various local or loopback IP ranges.

methods.name: isLoopback
methods.description: Checks if a given host string refers to a loopback address.

methods.name: isLoopbackHost
methods.description: Contains the core logic to determine if a host is a loopback address.

methods.name: isLocalNetworkHost
methods.description: Determines if a host belongs to local network ranges or is a loopback.

methods.name: parseIPv4
methods.description: Parses an IPv4 address string into a tuple of four UInt8 bytes.

methods.name: isLocalNetworkIPv4
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address falls within known local network ranges.
